items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: And I also met Ziggy Johnson, who was the big director of the first year, was producer from Larry Steele.

ctx.x: And I just accidentally met him when I went to visit Jay Golson, who used to be a manager in my band in Detroit. And I also met Ziggy Johnson, who was the big director of the first year, was producer from Larry Steele. I always thought that Ziggy was even a better producer than Larry Steele was. He worked with him. He worked with him. Yes I did. Ziggy produced the shows when he was on the plantation club and I told him it was Bill A. Stein. He had come out of Washington, Pennsylvania and was singing with the…
G-I-G-G-Y. Just the same old word.
